---
title: "DIP: what is there"
subtitle: "Exploration of the Bundestag and Bundesrat records fetched so far"
---

This notebook describes the DIP records selected by the fetch filter (`data/fetch/dip.yaml`):
how many there are, what kinds, and how much of the selection looks off-topic. It
informs how AI relevance and topics will be labelled later. Run `uv run germany-on-ai build`
first; the notebook reads `build/germany_on_ai.duckdb`.

```{python}
import duckdb

from germany_on_ai import notebook

notebook.setup()
db = duckdb.connect("../build/germany_on_ai.duckdb", read_only=True)
tables = [t for (t,) in db.sql("SELECT table_name FROM duckdb_tables() ORDER BY 1").fetchall()]
db.sql("""
    SELECT table_name AS "table", estimated_size AS records
    FROM duckdb_tables() ORDER BY table_name
""").df()
```

## Proceedings by electoral term and type

```{python}
db.sql("""
    PIVOT (SELECT data->>'vorgangstyp' AS type, 'WP ' || (data->>'wahlperiode') AS term
           FROM dip_vorgang)
    ON term USING count(*) GROUP BY type ORDER BY type
""").df()
```

## Which query found what

Each proceeding can match several parts of the fetch filter. Overlap shows how much each
descriptor or title term adds.

```{python}
db.sql("""
    WITH flags AS (
        SELECT
            id,
            list_contains(json_extract_string(data, '$.deskriptor[*].name'),
                          'Künstliche Intelligenz') AS ai_descriptor,
            list_contains(json_extract_string(data, '$.deskriptor[*].name'),
                          'Generative KI') AS genai_descriptor,
            regexp_matches(data->>'titel', '\\bKI\\b|[Kk]ünstliche')  AS ai_title
        FROM dip_vorgang
    )
    SELECT ai_descriptor, genai_descriptor, ai_title, count(*) AS n
    FROM flags GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC
""").df()
```

## Possible noise: neither AI descriptor nor AI title

These came in through the broad "Autonomes Waffensystem" descriptor (which DIP expands to
military robots and drones). A sample, to judge how much needs filtering later.

```{python}
db.sql("""
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT data->>'wahlperiode' AS term, data->>'vorgangstyp' AS type,
               data->>'titel' AS title
        FROM dip_vorgang
        WHERE NOT list_contains(json_extract_string(data, '$.deskriptor[*].name'),
                                'Künstliche Intelligenz')
          AND NOT regexp_matches(data->>'titel', '\\bKI\\b|[Kk]ünstliche')
    ) USING SAMPLE 20 ROWS (reservoir, 42)
""").df()
```

## Plenary passages over time

```{python}
if "dip_passage" in tables:
    display(db.sql("""
        SELECT substr(data->>'datum', 1, 4) AS year, data->>'herausgeber' AS house,
               count(*) AS passages,
               count(DISTINCT data->>'plenarprotokoll_id') AS sessions
        FROM dip_passage GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY year, house
    """).df())
else:
    print("No passages yet: transcripts have not been ingested.")
```
